text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen has arrived—

Countless fans packed into Nakayama 
Racecourse to witness the grand Prix 
featuring the finest Umamusume 
representing that year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, feel that heat! It's that time of 
the year again, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think's gonna win? Gentildonna, 
obviously! For sure, she's the strongest 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... it's your first time running 
at Nakayama, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You avoided it 'cause it's a tough course, 
right? If you just pick and choose your 
tracks... can you really call yourself the 
strongest?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine, no problem. Because—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I get what you're saying! But for me, 
there's something else I wanna 
prioritize—"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text: "...I believe in you. Because—"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text: Because you are the strongest.

While the visitors were full of excitement 
and high expectations... she, the star of 
the show, also couldn't hide her 
exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It's quite curious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To seek power, cultivate it, and wield it. 
I do so simply because I am worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And yet, for it to ache like this... Could 
it be that part of me truly wants to be 
seen?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufufufu...! You caught me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then... But if all you want to do is 
show off, your power's aim will waver.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is a Trainer's job. Would you mind 
calming down?

At her request, I reach out a hand to 
Gentildonna. She gently... with absolute, 
perfect precision in her grip, squeezed 
back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...These hands will lift me up to even 
greater heights, won't they?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“There can be only one winner. However, 
today—”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Just the two of us, isn't it?
choice_data_list: I'm leaving it in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, are you sure that little load is 
enough for you?
choice_data_list:
If I felt light to you, you're seriously 
underestimating me.

If I felt light to you, you're 
underestimating me a bit.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Giggle, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That weight— I have received it in full.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have arranged seats for my family at the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please come see it in person. We shall 
show you our strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, your emotions got the 
better of you, did they? It seems you 
still have some childishness left in you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle. To think a man of Father's 
stature... would harbor such unexpectedly 
romantic thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I merely chose the best 
possible approach. Watch the race, and you 
will surely understand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A naive, foolish father blinded by 
affection for his child, who misjudged 
someone... Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Father...? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
No. ...Watch closely yourself. To see what 
Gentildonna will become—
(Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Nobody's paying attention to me. But... 
I don't want to just be background 
decoration.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be... the star of the Grand 
Prix...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: (—It feels so pleasant.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(There is no one in this race who isn't 
formidable.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Some folks say, "The home stretch at 
Nakayama is short!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan can use warp, y'know☆ Warp, I 
tell ya, warp!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
――Don't think you can beat the Galaxy just 
by being "the strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Truly pleasant...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be in high spirits, 
Gentildonna-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so. How are you feeling, 
Verxina?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look very promising to me, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm in top condition. So much so that 
I'm confident... I can defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you letting your guard down a bit 
too much? I may have suffered defeat after 
defeat against you—and yet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure you want to say that there's no 
reason to believe the same will happen 
today, but..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Do you truly believe that? Because you――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You love it when I'm stronger than anyone 
else, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, you really are something else...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, I'll prove it on the track. 
Using sheer force—just the way you like 
it!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then... You're the last one, Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am a great King. My hoofprints bear 
testament to that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: However... there is a small scratch on it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Gentil. —It's you."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"When I consider the vast reign that lies 
ahead of me... this is a small, 
insignificant scratch."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot tolerate it. It must be 
corrected before it festers.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"How pitiful. That wound of yours will 
only cut deeper now."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As the 'mightiest of all,' I will be the 
one standing at the pinnacle.
